div.div: The Executor sends docker commands and tar streams; credentials go only on stdin, never on a command line or into an image. No bind mounts: every file moves as a tar stream, so the same steps work locally and over SSH. Timing is taken inside the container, so SSH latency never reaches a measurement. Hidden tests are in no image: they are copied in after the agent exits, with the network cut.

text.tspan: The Executor sends docker commands and tar streams; credentials go only on stdin, never on a command line or into an image. No bind
mounts: every file moves as a tar stream, so the same steps work locally and over SSH. Timing is taken inside the container, so SSH latency
never reaches a measurement. Hidden tests are in no image: they are copied in after the agent exits, with the network cut.
